dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately concave curvature along the trailing edge, forming a falcate profile from the mid-ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium pixel radius; lacks acute tapering.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree inclination relative to the visible dorsal midline.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, high-radius convexity defining a prominent and rounded melon region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt rostrum with a high thickness-to-length ratio extending from the cranial base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the transition point between the melon's descent and the rostrum's emergence.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced longitudinal high-luminance band/specular highlight along the dorsal-lateral axis; visible ocular region positioned posterior to the rostrum base.
